Install Process Design Calculator

Add Process Design Calculator to your home screen for quick access to both calculators.

iPhone or iPad

Open this link in Safari. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen and Add. Enable “Open as Web App” if offered.

Android

Open this link in Chrome. Tap the ⋮ menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen.

On a computer

In Chrome or Edge, use the install icon in the address bar or the browser menu. In Safari on Mac, choose File → Add to Dock.

In an in-app browser? Open this page in your device’s browser first. Installation options depend on your browser.
